paragraphs.text: Galed is one of daen Dwynen 's elite warriors of the Gilt-Leaf on Lorwyn .

When Nissa Revane arrived on the plane of Lorwyn, she immediately made a connection with the plane. She felt pain there, the coming of the Great Aurora . When she recovered, she was confronted by Dwynen's pack of elves, including Galed. They were chasing eyeblights and accepted Nissa's alien beauty, forcing her to join the hunt. After a while, she realized that Dwynen's pack was hunting and killing innocent boggarts . Just as she confronted the elves about this, the Great Aurora arrived and changed Lorwyn to Shadowmoor, and Nissa planeswalked away.
